limits: This verifies the union and consistency of previously accepted certificates; it does not rerun earlier solvers or graph verifiers.
The exclusion is conditional on direct standard decryption, fixed squares, registered orientations and the stated endpoint. It does not solve Rev7 or classify it as modern/classical.
